title: Loaders and actions
summary: A route owns its reads and writes. Components render their results.

sections.title: Browser-only data
sections.body: clientLoader and clientAction run in the browser. Use these for local storage or requests to your own API. They do not create backend endpoints.

sections.title: Server data
sections.body: loader and action execute on the server when using the generated transport or serverRoute. handleRequest must be installed on your production server. Exporting a server handler in a plain browser route table does not move that code to a backend automatically.

sections.title: Client call-through
sections.body: With serverRoute or the Vite-generated browser route table, a client handler can call its paired server handler. Read client action form data freely: the transport preserves a clone for serverAction. SSR runs server handlers and skips client handlers.

sections.title: Pending, errors, cancellation
sections.body: A newer request aborts the older request on the same channel. Pass signal to fetch and other abort-aware work. Returned or rejected errors become route error state. HydrateFallback renders before the first successful loader; ErrorBoundary receives an error prop. An error does not undo writes already committed by a server.
